items.title: ABYSS
items.description: A cinematic exploration of depth, darkness, and bioluminescent life beneath an imagined ocean.
items.deliverables:
Real-Time WebGL World
Custom GLSL Shaders
Spatial Soundscape
items.narrative: Constructed as a meditative abyssal chamber 4,000 meters below the surface, ABYSS pairs procedural soft-body flora with bioluminescent spore fields that react subtly to viewer presence and current turbulence.

items.title: ORBITAL
items.description: A visual system built around floating structures, planetary forms, and impossible architecture.
items.deliverables:
Brand World System
3D Key Visuals
Motion Identity
items.narrative: ORBITAL investigates monumental stillness in zero gravity: anisotropic brushed-titanium rings suspended around a dark mineral core, illuminated solely by grazing blue planetary bounce light.

items.title: TIDELINE
items.description: A digital identity designed around movement, fluidity, and the rhythm of changing water.
items.deliverables:
Fluid Shader Engine
Interactive Flagship
Editorial Typography
items.narrative: Driven by multi-octave Gerstner wave equations and specular Fresnel reflections, TIDELINE transforms tidal telemetry into a living metallic-liquid horizon that shifts weight with every gesture.

items.title: ECHO
items.description: An experimental digital world where sound, movement, and visual depth respond to the user.
items.deliverables:
Harmonic Geometry Rig
Pointer-Reactive Field
Exhibition Installation
items.narrative: ECHO translates harmonic frequencies into suspended sculptural waves and concentric acoustic rings, allowing visitors to perturb standing-wave geometry in real time.
